name: cap-screen-recorder
title: Cap Screen Recorder
description: Start and stop Cap.so recordings and open your Cap dashboard directly from Raycast.
author: CapSoftware

commands.name: start-recording
commands.title: Start Recording
commands.description: Start a new Cap screen recording with your default capture settings

commands.name: stop-recording
commands.title: Stop Recording
commands.description: Stop the active Cap recording and copy the shareable video link

commands.name: open-dashboard
commands.title: Open Cap Dashboard
commands.description: Open your Cap.so web dashboard in the default browser

preferences.name: captureTargetType
preferences.title: Capture Target Type
preferences.description: Whether to capture a Screen or a Window by name

preferences.name: targetName
preferences.title: Target Screen or Window Name
preferences.description: Display or window name resolved by Cap (e.g. Built-in Retina Display)

preferences.name: captureSystemAudio
preferences.title: Capture System Audio
preferences.description: Include system audio when starting a recording
preferences.label: Capture System Audio

preferences.name: dashboardUrl
preferences.title: Cap Dashboard URL
preferences.description: Your Cap web instance URL (defaults to https://cap.so/dashboard)
